en.headline: Postman dies after falling from Ming Wah Mansion in Shau Kei Wan
en.dek: A 57-year-old Hongkong Post employee was found unconscious outside the building around 8:30 a.m. and later pronounced dead at Eastern Hospital; the cause remains under investigation.
body: A 57-year-old postman was found unconscious after falling from height at Ming Wah Mansion on A Kung Ngam Road in Shau Kei Wan on Tuesday morning and was later pronounced dead at Eastern Hospital.

Police received a report at about 8:30 a.m. of a man lying on the ground outside Block A of the estate. Rescuers sent him to hospital, where he was certified dead. The building was undergoing external wall maintenance with scaffolding and protective netting in place. Items including a shoe and a belt were found at the scene.

The man was wearing a postal uniform and was not a resident of the building. Hongkong Post staff attended the hospital to assist police. The Hong Kong Postal Workers Union said the deceased was a long-serving permanent employee of about 30 years who had been performing indoor duties at the start of his shift before leaving the workplace. Police said no suicide note was found and the cause of death will be determined after a post-mortem examination.

zh.headline: 筲箕灣明華大廈郵差墮樓送院不治
zh.dek: 57歲香港郵政員工今早約8時半被發現倒臥明華大廈外昏迷，送東區醫院後證實不治，死因有待調查。
body: 一名57歲郵差星期二早上於筲箕灣阿公岩道明華大廈高處墮下，被發現昏迷，其後送往東區醫院搶救後證實不治。
警方約8時半接報，一名男子倒臥A座對開地面。救援人員將他送院。現場大廈正進行外牆維修，搭有棚架及圍網，地上遺下鞋及腰帶等物。
死者身穿郵差制服，並非大廈住戶。香港郵政職員到醫院協助警方調查。香港郵務職工會表示，死者為入職約30年的長俸員工，今早原本進行內勤工作期間離開辦公地點。警方表示未有發現遺書，死因有待驗屍後確定。
